treaty_name: Convention between Algeria and Lebanon for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2002)
eif_quote: [LB MoF matrix] Algeria March 26, 2002 August 29, 2002 July 19, 2006 Law N. 456 || [DZ DGI list] لبنان | سارية المفعول ابتداء من 19/07/2009 ... 26/03/2002 لبنان
source_title: JORA n° 35 du 28 mai 2006 – Décret présidentiel n° 06-171 portant ratification de la convention Algérie–Liban (Beyrouth, 26 mars 2002), French edition

rates.quote: Cependant si celui qui reçoit les bénéfices est le bénéficiaire effectif des dividendes et qui est résident de l’autre Etat contractant, l’impôt ainsi établi ne peut excéder 15 % du montant brut global des dividendes.
mais si la personne qui reçoit l’intérêt en est le bénéficiaire effectif, l’impôt ainsi établi ne peut excéder 10% du montant brut de l’intérêt.
mais si la personne qui reçoit les redevances en est le bénéficiaire effectif, l’impôt ainsi établi ne peut excéder 10% du montant brut des redevances

ppt.quote: Algeria signed the MLI (27-06-2024) but has not ratified it (per map_CD/OECD status); the treaty text contains no principal purpose test.

notes: Art. 27: in force on the 30th day after the last notification; WHT applies to income attributed on or after 1 January of the calendar year following entry into force. EIF conflict: 19-07-2006 (Lebanon MoF matrix, used) vs 19/07/2009 (Algeria DGI list); valid_from 2007-01-01 follows the Lebanese date (would be 2010-01-01 on the Algerian date). Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)) when beneficially owned by the other government/local authorities/state agencies or banks, or debt guaranteed/insured/financed by a wholly state-owned financial institution of the other State. Authentic text Arabic only; read the official French JORA edition. No MLI.
unverified: Entry-into-force date conflict (2006 vs 2009) unresolved; affects valid_from only.
